payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes maximum sharpness for odd n using 1D DP recurrence dp[i]=dp[i-2]+2i-2, then finds smallest n with dp[n]>=x.
payload.rationale: Solution uses a 1D DP table where state i (odd size) stores maximum ones achievable, transition from i-2. It then scans to find minimal n for given x. No higher-dimensional state or complex structure.
